name: FourierMask
label: Fourier Mask
description: Keep only the parts of the spectrum selected by a mask volume and transform back to real space. Build the mask on a 'Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)' branch of the data: Binary Threshold to pick out the peaks, then optionally Connected Components and Remove Labels to drop the ones you do not want. Non-zero mask voxels are kept, their Friedel mates are added, and the edges are softened so the cut does not ring.

parameters.name: mask
parameters.label: Mask
parameters.description: Volume of the same shape whose non-zero voxels mark the reciprocal-space regions to keep, such as a Binary Threshold of a 'Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)' branch.

parameters.name: edge_softness
parameters.label: Edge Softness (bins)
parameters.description: Gaussian blur applied to the mask edges, in frequency bins. 0 keeps the hard mask.

parameters.name: include_friedel_mates
parameters.label: Include Friedel Mates
parameters.description: Also keep the mirror of the mask through the spectrum center, which the symmetric spectrum of real data requires.

parameters.name: invert
parameters.label: Invert Mask
parameters.description: Remove the selected regions instead of keeping them.
